title: Gas sponsorship for eligible trades
summary: We're preparing gas sponsorship for eligible trades you review in Oren. When enabled, Oren covers the Solana network fee.

items.title: Coverage for eligible first buys
items.description: Sponsorship can also cover the cost of creating the token account that receives your stock on an eligible first purchase.

items.title: Check fees before approving
items.description: The trade review shows any fees you pay. Sponsorship applies to eligible trades reviewed in Oren with an embedded wallet.
